decision_basis: The authoritative ELF comparison corrected the stale 260-byte manifest metadata to 352 bytes for both stock and candidate.
Two independent Docker canonical-build cycles produced the same zte_tpd.ko SHA-256.
Candidate and stock AArch64 assembly have identical 88 instructions, 352-byte symbol size and resolved relocations.
Candidate and stock KCFI type IDs are identical: 0xcdde824b.
Strict Joern gate passed with zero parse problems and one-to-one source/Ghidra identity coverage.
The next13 firmware lifecycle harness passed 12/12 tests in both cycles, directly covering this allocator's success and failure paths.
